# Panthera Corbett Safari

> Authorized Jim Corbett safari booking operator and wildlife tour specialist based in Ramnagar, Uttarakhand, India. Operates official Dhikala Canter safaris, private 4x4 Gypsy safaris across all core and buffer zones, Forest Rest House (FRH) night stays inside the reserve, private Delhi-Corbett cab transfers, and curated wildlife holiday packages.

## Core Safari & Travel Services
- [Jim Corbett Jeep Safari](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/jeep-safari): Exclusive private 4x4 Gypsy safaris for up to 6 guests across Bijrani, Jhirna, Dhela, Garjiya, Durga Devi, Phato, and Sitabani zones. Government entry permit, authorized naturalist guide, 4x4 vehicle hire, and driver included.
- [Dhikala Canter Safari](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/canter-safari): Official 16-seater sharing open safari bus into Dhikala core zone. Fixed ₹2,299/person with pickup & drop from Ramnagar / Dhangarhi Gate. Season: 15 Nov – 15 Jun. Only 4 canters permitted per shift.
- [Jim Corbett Safari Pricing Guide](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/safari-price): Complete transparent fee schedule for all Corbett zones, canter sharing vs jeep hire, Indian vs foreign national tariffs, and advance booking windows.
- [Delhi to Jim Corbett Packages](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/delhi-to-jim-corbett-package): All-inclusive 2N/3D and weekend tour packages from Delhi NCR starting at ₹11,500/couple with private road transfers, luxury wildlife resort stays, and confirmed core zone safaris.
- [Delhi to Jim Corbett Private Cab](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/delhi-corbett-cab): Door-to-door private cab service between Delhi Airport / NCR and Ramnagar from ₹4,500 (Sedan: Dzire/Etios) and ₹6,500 (SUV: Innova Crysta). Tolls, parking, and driver allowance included.
- [Panthera Corbett Wildlife Blog](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/blog): In-depth editorial travel guides, zone comparisons, packing checklists, seasonal guides, and permit booking strategies.

## Safari Zones (Jim Corbett Tiger Reserve)
- [Dhikala Zone](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/zones/dhikala-zone): Corbett's premier core zone. 32 km inside Dhangarhi Gate along the Ramganga reservoir. Celebrated for Bengal tigers, Asian elephants, and gharials. Day visits via Canter (₹2,299/person); jeep safaris reserved exclusively for overnight Forest Rest House guests. Season: 15 Nov – 15 Jun.
- [Bijrani Zone](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/zones/bijrani-zone): Prime core zone closest to Ramnagar (1 km via Amdanda Gate). Thick sal forest and grasslands with the highest tiger sighting density. Private 4x4 Gypsy from ₹7,999/jeep. Season: 15 Oct – 30 Jun.
- [Jhirna Zone](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/zones/jhirna-zone): Southern core zone open 365 days a year including monsoon. Highest sloth bear population, wild elephants, and deer herds. Private 4x4 Gypsy from ₹7,999/jeep.
- [Dhela Zone](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/zones/dhela-zone): Eco-tourism core zone opened in 2014, open 365 days. Strictly capped at 15 jeeps per shift for an unhurried, quiet experience. Mixed forest, waterholes, and birdlife. Private Gypsy from ₹7,999/jeep.
- [Garjiya Zone](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/zones/garjiya-zone): Core zone along the rugged Kosi riverbed, 12 km from Ramnagar. Stellar tiger movement record. Private 4x4 Gypsy from ₹7,999/jeep. Season: 15 Oct – 30 Jun.
- [Durga Devi Zone](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/zones/durga-devi-zone): Northeastern hilly core zone (28 km from Ramnagar). Ramganga & Mandal river gorges, golden mahseer pools, leopards, and rare raptors. Best for birding and angling. Private Gypsy from ₹7,999/jeep. Season: 15 Oct – 15 Jun.
- [Phato Zone](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/zones/phato-zone): Buffer zone with iconic wooden treehouse stopover, open 365 days. Frequent tiger and elephant sightings. Private Gypsy at fixed ₹6,499/jeep.
- [Hathidangar Zone](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/zones/hathidangar-zone): Buffer zone in the Ampokhra range, open 365 days. Active elephant corridor and waterholes. Private Gypsy at fixed ₹6,499/jeep.
- [Sitabani Reserve](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/zones/sitabani-zone): Historic reserve forest buffer zone with 3 gates (Teda, Bhandarpani, Pawalgarh), open 365 days. No government quota cap; easy same-day availability. From ₹5,999/jeep.

---

## Forest Rest Houses (FRH Core Zone Night Stays)
- [Dhikala Forest Rest House](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/forest-rest-houses/dhikala-forest-rest-house): Historic British-era heritage lodge (32 rooms) inside Dhikala core zone on the Ramganga reservoir bank. 45-day advance government permit window. ₹9,500/night.
- [Gairal Forest Rest House](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/forest-rest-houses/gairal-forest-rest-house): Intimate 6-room lodge situated right on the Ramganga riverbank, 16 km inside Dhangarhi Gate. Known for silence, river views, and elephant sightings. ₹8,500/night.
- [Bijrani Forest Rest House](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/forest-rest-houses/bijrani-forest-rest-house): 6-room forest bungalow inside Bijrani core zone. Offers the distinct privilege of being the first vehicle on tiger tracks before day jeeps enter. ₹7,500/night.

## Wildlife Holiday Packages
- [Dhikala FRH 2N/3D Immersion](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/packages/dhikala-frh-2n-3d): 2 nights inside Dhikala/Gairal FRH, 4 private Gypsy safaris, government entry permits, meals, and Ramnagar transfers. ₹28,500/couple.
- [Bijrani Weekend Safari 1N/2D](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/packages/bijrani-weekend-safari): Luxury resort stay + 2 private jeep safaris in Bijrani zone + all meals. ₹11,500/couple.
- [Corbett Double Zone Safari 2N/3D](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/packages/corbett-double-zone-safari): 3 private Gypsy safaris across two distinct zones (Bijrani + Jhirna/Dhela) + 2 nights luxury resort + meals. ₹18,500/couple.
- [Dhikala Canter Day Trip 1N/2D](https://pantheracorbettsafari.corbettcamp.com/packages/dhikala-canter-day-trip): 1 night resort stay + confirmed Dhikala Canter safari seat + meals. ₹8,500/couple.

## Essential Booking Rules & Tiger Reserve Guidelines
1. **Government Identity Proof:** Original government photo ID (Aadhaar Card, Passport, or Voter ID) is strictly mandatory for booking and park entry. The exact ID provided during booking must be carried physically during safari.
2. **Non-Transferable & Non-Refundable:** As per Corbett Tiger Reserve guidelines, safari permits once issued by the Forest Department are strictly non-transferable and non-refundable under any circumstances.
3. **Daily Shift Timings:**
   - Morning Shift: 06:00 AM – 09:30 AM (Entry closes ~06:30 AM)
   - Evening Shift: 02:00 PM – 05:30 PM (Entry closes ~02:30 PM)
4. **Advance Reservation Timelines:**
   - Dhikala Canter Safari: Recommended 15–20 days ahead (only 4 buses per shift).
   - Core Zone Jeep Safari (Bijrani, Jhirna, Dhela, Garjiya): Recommended 30–45 days ahead.
   - Forest Rest House (Dhikala/Gairal): Quota opens exactly 45 days in advance at 00:00 IST for Indian nationals (90 days for foreign nationals).
   - Buffer Zones (Phato, Sitabani): Available on 24–48 hours notice or same-day.
5. **Reserve Etiquette:** Plastic polybags, smoking, alcohol, loud noises, and stepping out of the safari vehicle are strictly prohibited and attract heavy Forest Department penalties.
